body:
Final evidence audit: the report must distinguish architectural recommendations from implementation proof. Claim graph C-02/03/04/05/06/07/10/11 remains partial/unresolved and therefore maps to explicit Phase-0 spikes: physical dual-monitor flows, venue-like network/reconnect, Korean STT, RAG/verifier quality, public diode/projection, WSS semantics, ACL/RLS, and pairing UX. Official docs prove capability constraints, not that our implementation meets them.

All quality/performance gates must use two disjoint datasets: bake-off/dev data for provider/config choice, then frozen pre-adjudicated acceptance data with sampling frame, severity taxonomy, denominators, clocks, thresholds, and exclusions preregistered before unblinding. If acceptance data changes the system, burn it and create a new holdout. Retain raw outputs/evaluator versions.

Do not sum component p95 allocations and call the result E2E p95. Gate on an empirical correlated end-to-end trace from preregistered semantic-audio-end to terminal recommendation/abstention; component spans are diagnostic only.

After per-role streams, displayBindingEpoch reconciliation, CAS publication, and bounded live-card leases, remaining gates are decidable only with these definitions: deterministic semantic-audio-end reference and monotonic clock correlation; exact lease exposure/tombstone ACK events including offline behavior; preregistered human rubrics/rater/fail criteria for render fidelity and pairing usability; provider deletion terminal SUCCESS only on receipt, otherwise explicit EXCEPTION/BLOCKED after deadline. With these added, no material state/evidence gate remains undecidable.
summary: Final evidence closure and holdout rules
